fields.description:
## Context / Problem
Fourteen test files hand-build a nested pytest invocation (`[sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", ...]`),
each re-deciding basetemp, timeout, cache plugin and stdin. The `--basetemp` defect arrived as three
separate CLOSED bugs (RCA: session log `0bd6-4729-e79e-433b`); all are fixed, the duplication that
made them three instalments is not. Three sites still carry no `--basetemp`:
`tests/integration/test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py:25` (EXECUTES three real
integration nodes — a live instance of the defect, missed earlier as `pytest.mark.integration`) and
the `--collect-only` children `tests/unit/test_git_version_floor.py:165` and
`tests/unit/test_live_jira_xdist_confinement.py:162`.

## Approach
Add `tests/_nested_pytest.py`:

    run_nested_pytest(tmp_path, *args, timeout, env, cwd=REPO_ROOT, no_cacheprovider=True)
        -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]

### Constraints the implementation MUST respect
- `env` is REQUIRED and forwarded VERBATIM — never merged onto `os.environ`, never re-wrapped, no
  key added or removed. Four sites hand the child a deliberately minimal two/three-key mapping so
  pytest's bounded mapping repr cannot truncate the sentinel away; widening it leaves those security
  oracles green and vacuous: `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_env_repr_security.py:31` and, under
  `tests/unit/`, `test_environ_assert_repr_security.py:134`, `test_fixture_env_repr_security.py:49`,
  `test_subprocess_env_repr_security.py:189`.
- Contract pinned by `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_deadline_heldout.py`: `env` must survive as a
  plain `dict` (`:39` supplies `{"PATH": "test-path"}`, so the helper may NOT call `SubprocessEnv`
  methods on it); `timeout` is passed to `subprocess.run` as a KEYWORD (`:42`, asserted `>= 30`); the
  `CompletedProcess` is returned UNMODIFIED (`:51`, `result is nested_result`).
- No `check`; `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` propagates so
  `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py:105-108` keeps its own diagnostic conversion.
- Always appends `--basetemp <tmp_path>/<name>`, `-p no:cacheprovider` (suppressible — the parity
  collector omits it), `stdin=DEVNULL`, `capture_output=True`, `text=True`.

### Per-site divergences that stay at the call site as `*args` — do NOT normalise
`-n 0` (authorship); `-p no:randomly` (engine-dir, ci-snapshot); `-p conftest` (repo-isolation
guard); `-rs` (external isolation); `--collect-only` (parity, git-floor, live-Jira);
`--tb=<style>`/`--showlocals` (the four repr-security sites); timeouts 30/90/300/None per site; and
cwd — `tests/unit/test_ci_snapshot_fixture_cleanup.py:61` passes NO `cwd`, kept via `cwd=None`.

### Two sites are OUT of scope by design — do NOT convert
`tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py:154` (bug 291e) and
`tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py:92` (bug a371) spawn the BARE `pytest` console script
from a cwd outside the repo precisely so the repo root cannot reach `sys.path`. Converting them
inserts cwd and destroys both reproductions.

### Guard shape
Black splits argv one element per line, so a grep for `"-m", "pytest"` is empty on unmodified `main`;
the guard is therefore an AST scan over `tests/**/*.py` for `subprocess.run`/`Popen` whose first
argument is a list literal holding `sys.executable`, `"-m"`, `"pytest"` in sequence. The unquoted
`-m pytest` (23 prose hits) is deliberately unmatched.

## Guard construction
Follow the guard-test construction rule in the parent epic `airborne-wellloved-kingfisher`, adapted
from `src/rebar` to `tests/` because the owner module is a test helper. This construct has no
distinctive single atom that survives formatting, so branch 4 of the rule applies: assert the
DEFINITION count (exactly one `def run_nested_pytest` under `tests/`) alongside the AST launch-site
scan described in Approach. The owner module `tests/_nested_pytest.py` is exempt; the escape marker
is `# nested-pytest-ok: <reason>`; behaviour is pinned only by the existing tests named in Scope.

## Scope
New: `tests/_nested_pytest.py`, `tests/unit/test_nested_pytest_helper.py`,
`tests/unit/test_nested_pytest_uniqueness.py`.

Converted (14): `tests/_store_isolation.py:33`,
`tests/integration/test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py:25` (+`--basetemp`),
`tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_env_repr_security.py:24`; under `tests/unit/`:
`test_authorship_fixture_maintenance.py:43`, `test_ci_snapshot_fixture_cleanup.py:61`,
`test_ci_workflow_parity.py:839`, `test_engine_dir.py:188`,
`test_environ_assert_repr_security.py:141`, `test_external_isolation.py:63`,
`test_fixture_env_repr_security.py:54`, `test_git_version_floor.py:165` (+`--basetemp`),
`test_live_jira_xdist_confinement.py:162` (+`--basetemp`), `test_repo_isolation_guard.py:82`,
`test_subprocess_env_repr_security.py:195`.

Pinning consumers (unedited, but run to prove the conversion), under `tests/unit/`:
`test_repo_isolation_deadline_heldout.py`; `test_ci_workflow_parity_basetemp.py` (imports
`_collect_node_ids` by name; pins `PYTEST_DEBUG_TEMPROOT` survival);
`test_test_suite_store_isolation.py`; `test_test_suite_store_isolation_heldout.py`.

NOT converted (reason in the helper docstring): the two bare-console-script sites above, and the
`pytester.runpytest*` calls in `tests/unit/test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py` and
`tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py` (pytest already manages their basetemp).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly one nested-pytest launch site under `tests/`, and one helper definition. Checked by
  `test_nested_pytest_uniqueness.py::test_the_launch_appears_only_in_the_helper` (AST scan; a grep
  would pass vacuously) and `grep -rn '^def run_nested_pytest' tests/` returning one line.
- [ ] The two bare-console-script launches survive unconverted (converting inserts cwd on `sys.path`
  and voids bugs 291e and a371). Checked by
  `grep -rln 'Path(sys.executable).parent / "pytest"' tests/` returning exactly those two modules,
  both passing unchanged.
- [ ] Every nested run's basetemp is under the caller's `tmp_path`. Checked by
  `test_nested_pytest_helper.py::test_the_child_basetemp_is_owned_by_the_caller` and
  `grep -rln -- '--basetemp' tests/` returning only `tests/_nested_pytest.py`.
- [ ] A caller-supplied env mapping reaches the child byte-identically, no key added or removed, so
  the four minimal-env repr-security oracles stay non-vacuous. Checked by
  `test_nested_pytest_helper.py::test_the_caller_environment_is_forwarded_verbatim` plus those four
  modules, unedited.
- [ ] `timeout` reaches `subprocess.run` as a keyword, the `CompletedProcess` is returned unmodified,
  and `TimeoutExpired` propagates (hang case asserts the raise only — no wall-clock assertion, marked
  `# timing: hang-guard`). Checked by `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_deadline_heldout.py` passing
  unedited (`kwargs["timeout"] >= 30`, `result is nested_result`) and by
  `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py` keeping its own timeout diagnostic.
- [ ] Every per-site divergence listed above is preserved, not normalised. Checked by
  `git diff origin/main -- tests/` showing each flag still at its call site, and the fourteen
  modules passing unedited.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit zero.
- [ ] The parity collector stays importable by name and `PYTEST_DEBUG_TEMPROOT` reaches the
  store-isolation child. Checked by `test_ci_workflow_parity_basetemp.py` and
  `test_test_suite_store_isolation.py::test_nested_pytest_does_not_clean_shared_numbered_temp_root`
  (all three parametrisations) passing unchanged.
- [ ] The converted files pass the default `Verified` tier (`-n 4 --dist worksteal` ubuntu, `-n 3`
  macOS — `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:657`), the `--dist loadgroup` lane (`:672`) and the
  `integration` tier. Checked by CI.
